title: Magazines in the squat
situation: You are {{Connor}}. In a side room of the derelict building where the suspect has been nesting, there are magazines on the floor. {{Hank}} is checking the next room.

media.title: Green Earth: Past the Tipping Point
facts: Scientists say the climate has passed its irreversible tipping point; rainforests are down 79 percent since 2000 and the planet will only get hotter.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: Red Ice Epidemic
facts: The drug red ice contains the blue blood that powers androids and is ravaging the city's unemployed underclass; dealers say where the blood is blue, the ice is red and the money is green.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: {{Hank}} on the ledge
situation: You are {{Connor}}. You are chasing a deviant called {{Rupert}} across rooftops; he is a key lead to the pattern of deviancy and may know where runaway androids go. {{Hank}} tried to cut him off and has gone over the edge of a roof. He is hanging from the gutter by his fingers, several stories up. Your analysis says he can probably pull himself up, but there is real risk. {{Rupert}} is getting away.
